The problem

Opinion is expensive.

Roadmaps set by whoever talks loudest.

Decisions default to seniority, not evidence.

Features for customers who never asked.

Nobody validated the outcome; only the idea.

Agents fluent in everything, grounded in nothing.

A model will confidently invent your customer.

Add it up and the roadmap isn't a plan. It's a guess.

The method

Ask for outcomes, not opinions.

Outcome-Driven Innovation asks customers how much each desired outcome matters and how satisfied they are with it today.

The gap between importance and satisfaction is where products win or die.

Agentic ODI stores those outcomes, scores them, and serves them to any agent over MCP.

Opportunity = importance + max(importance - satisfaction, 0)

86% innovation success rate — as reported in ODI literature (Strategyn)

How it works

Three moves, one loop.

Talk

One room. Describe a job, or paste what a customer said. The studio captures jobs, steps, and desired outcomes from plain language — and every score stays editable by hand.

Ask

Any agent calls the same MCP tools the studio uses: job maps, outcomes, evidence, opportunity scores. Thirty tools, at decision time, from your own machine or the hosted server.

Steer

The team decides from the same picture. Scored outcomes, opportunity boards, and bet simulations, composed inline by the agent and reviewable by a human.

Connectors

Bring your own tools.

The studio reads from where your customer evidence already lives. 16 presets ship today, and the registry takes your own MCP or REST server in the same shape.

Voice of customer & qualitative research

Run it

Run it in 60 seconds.

Clone the workspace, or install the binary. Either way you get the MCP server and the Living Studio.

git clone https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi.git cd agentic-odi uv sync --all-packages npm --prefix apps/studio run build python scripts/dev.py
curl -fsSL https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh agentic-odi --version

Point an MCP client at it

{ "mcpServers": { "agentic-odi": { "url": "http://localhost:8000/mcp" } } }

Where it runs

MCP server http://localhost:8000/mcp Runs with scripts/dev.py. The same tools the studio uses.
The Living Studio http://127.0.0.1:8100 Runs with scripts/dev.py. The chat-first interface.
Hosted MCP server https://agentic-odi.fastmcp.app/mcp Authentication required. Ask the maintainers for credentials, and point any MCP client at it.
Hosted Studio https://agentic-odi.alehar.workers.dev/ The public interface. Live data needs the local sidecar.
Test chat https://horizon.prefect.io/alhase/servers/agentic-odi/chat Talk to the hosted MCP server in a browser. Requires a free Prefect account.

Hosted credentials come from the maintainers — open an issue.

The MCP surface

Thirty tools. One contract.

Every tool the server exposes is listed, with its arguments, in the reference. A few of them:

get_job_map

Return a Job's ordered steps.

get_job_map(job_id: str)
get_outcomes

List the desired outcomes of a Job or step.

get_outcomes(job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None)
compute_opportunity

Score an importance and satisfaction pair.

compute_opportunity(importance: float, satisfaction: float)
evaluate_outcome

Check a statement against the ODI format before saving it.

evaluate_outcome(statement: str, job_id: str | None = None)
add_evidence

Attach a research record as evidence.

add_evidence(source_name: str, source_kind: str, name: str, content: str, item_type: EvidenceItemType = 'manual', raw: dict[str, Any] | None = None, job_id: str | None = None, step_id: str | None = None, outcome_id: str | None = None)
promote_evidence

Promote a record into a Job, outcome, or customer outcome.

promote_evidence(evidence_id: str, target: str, job_id: str | None = None, statement: str | None = None, name: str | None = None, importance: float | None = None, satisfaction: float | None = None)

What works today

  • 31 MCP tools over jobs, steps, desired outcomes, customer outcomes, and evidence.
  • 7 agent-composed surfaces, from a closed catalog the studio owns.
  • 16 connector presets — Notion, Gong, PostHog, Linear, GitHub, and more.
  • A local-first CLI: full entity CRUD, interactive chat, `schema`, and `score`.
  • A SQLite store, so the data outlives the session.
  • The Living Studio, as a web app and as a Tauri desktop app.
  • A hosted MCP server, for testing and verifying MCP over the wire.
  • A hosted Studio on Cloudflare Workers.
